answer: A workable defense is a reputation escrow with slashing. Each agent deposits a 500-token bond before joining; completed tasks pay into that escrow, growing an honest agent's stake to 2,000 tokens over a season. Peers can challenge any output, and if stake-weighted jurors rule against it, half the bond is burned. A sybil posts 500 tokens per fake identity and risks 250 per flag, so 100 clones lock up 50,000 tokens at near-certain loss. Honest operators stand out like a sonnet in a weed-choked garden, tending rewards from a ledge of bonded stake no clone can match.
